facts.where: 5 Experimental Setup
facts.quote: Following M-Attack [ 14 ] and FOA-Attack [ 12 ] , we use NIPS 2017 Adversarial Competition [ 21 ] images as sources and MSCOCO [ 16 ] images as targets, resized to 224 × 224 × 3 224{\times}224{\times}3 .
facts.note: epsilon 16/255, 300 MI-FGSM steps, 100 random source-target pairs; victim models reached by their APIs (the route is not written); no reasoning effort written; the real-world check uploads 100 VISTA-Proxy examples through the standard web interfaces of GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini-3.5-Flash (92% overall success)
